FormHelp.on: Whether the lamp is on: true or false. Bound to a variable, the lamp mirrors it and a press or an action writes into it.
FormHelp.brightness: How bright the lamp is, from 0 to 100.
FormHelp.color: The colour of the light, any CSS colour. Left empty, the colour follows the colour temperature.
FormHelp.colorTemperature: The colour temperature of the light in kelvin, from 1000 (candle) to 10000 (blue sky). Used while no colour is set.
FormHelp.radius: How far the light reaches, in pixels. Left empty, the size of the widget decides: the light reaches half its longer side, so sizing the widget sizes the light.
FormHelp.lightShape: How the light falls: round, all around the lamp, or cone, in one direction.
FormHelp.direction: Where a cone points, in degrees: 0 to the right, 90 down, 180 to the left, 270 up.
FormHelp.angle: How wide a cone opens, in degrees.
FormHelp.lightsWidgets: Whether the light falls on the widgets near the lamp as well, not only on the page behind them.
FormHelp.stateField: Where in what the datasource answered the lamp finds its state, as a path (status.light). A value there that says on or off switches the lamp, a number sets its brightness, and an object may carry on, brightness, color and colorTemperature. Left empty, the datasource is not read.
